content.title: Survivor 50: Everything You Need To Know
content.text: Survivor 50 airs tonight on CBS, and streams on Paramount+. With returning players and fan-determined game design, the anniversary Survivor season is historic. Jeff Probst hosts (and occasionally raps). Read on for a spoiler-free look at Survivor 50, including when the next episode airs, what time the show airs, when the season finale arrives, and how to stream episodes with Paramount+. Plus, watch a sneak peek from tonight’s episode, get an episode guide, and see photos of the full cast and the starting tribes. Get Started With Paramount+ When does the next episode of Survivor air? The next Survivor 50 episode, “Double the Fun, Double the Demise,” airs tonight, Wednesday, April 15, at 8 PM ET/PT on CBS. The 90-minute episode can be streamed live on Paramount+ as it airs on CBS with a subscription to the Paramount+ Premium plan. Starting tomorrow, Thursday, April 16, you can stream the episode on demand with a subscription to any Paramount+ plan. In “Double the Fun, Double the Demise,” the tribe members are asked to divide into pairs. Visit the official Survivor YouTube channel for preview clips of tonight’s episode, or watch a sneak peek here. In the below video, we see the aftermath of the latest tribal council. If you guessed some castaways are not happy, you guessed right! When’s the season finale? The Survivor 50 season finale airs from 8 PM-11 PM ET/PT, on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, on CBS. The three-hour episode streams live on Paramount+ with a subscription to the Paramount+ Premium plan. Additionally, you can stream the finale on demand on Paramount+ on the day after it airs with a subscription to any plan, either the Paramount+ Essential plan or the Paramount+ Premium plan. Where to watch Survivor? CBS Survivor 50 airs on CBS, and streams on Paramount+. New episodes launch weekly on Wednesdays through the season finale, and can be watched live as they air on CBS with your TV using cable, satellite, or a digital antenna. You can stream new episodes as they air live on CBS via Paramount+ with the Paramount+ Premium plan, and/or you can watch episodes on demand, the day after the air, with Paramount+ (any plan). See below for all the Survivor 50 tune-in info you need. Show: Survivor 50 New episodes air: Wednesdays at 8 PM ET/PT Channel: CBS Streaming: Paramount+* *New episodes of Survivor 50 can be streamed live on Paramount+ as they air on CBS with the Paramount+ Premium plan, or they can be streamed on the day after they air with any Paramount+ plan. How many episodes are there this season? As of this update, there are seven episodes of Survivor 50 now streaming on Paramount+. Episode No. 8, “Double the Fun, Double the Demise,” premieres tonight, Wednesday, April 15. In all, the season will consist of 13 episodes. As we said, the Survivor 50 season finale is set for Wednesday, May 20, 2026. Survivor 50 episode guide CBS Below is the Survivor 50 episode guide, featuring the list of aired and/or announced episodes: Survivor 50 episodes Episode 1: “Epic Party” (original air date: Feb. 25, 2026) Episode 2: “Therapy Carousel” (original air date: March 4, 2026) Episode 3: “Did You Vote for a Swap?” (original air date: March 11, 2026) Episode 4: “Knife to the Heart,” featuring country music star Zac Brown (original air date: March 18, 2026) Episode 5: “Open Wounds” (original air date: March 25, 2026) Episode 6: “The Blood Moon” (original air date: April 1, 2026) Episode 7: “That’s Not How I Play Survivor” (original air date: April 8, 2026) Episode 8: “Double the Fun, Double the Demise” (airing Wednesday, April 15, 2026) What is the Survivor 50 theme? The Survivor 50 theme is “In the Hands of the Fans,” with gameplay elements having been determined by fan voting that was conducted during Survivor 48. And when we say gameplay elements, we mean fans were asked to weigh in on everything from the color of the buffs, to whether the Survivor 50 winner should be revealed at a live reunion show in Los Angeles, or on the island right after the jury’s ballots have been cast. What are the starting tribes? The starting tribes of Survivor 50 are: Cila, Kalo, and Vatu. They launch with eight players each. Below is a breakdown of which players are in which tribe as of the Survivor 50 premiere. Cila tribe CBS The Survivor 50 Cila tribe is made up of: Rick Devens Cirie Fields Emily Flippen Christian Hubicki Joe Hunter Jenna Lewis-Dougherty Savannah Louie Ozzy Lusth Kalo tribe CBS The Survivor 50 Kalo tribe features: Charlie Davis Tiffany Ervin Chrissy Hofbeck Kamilla Karthigesu Dee Valladares Benjamin “Coach” Wade Mike White Jonathan Young Vatu tribe CBS The Survivor 50 Vatu tribe features: Aubry Bracco Q Burdette Colby Donaldson Kyle Fraser Angelina Keeley Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick Genevieve Mushaluk Rizo Velovic Who’s in the Survivor 50 cast? The Survivor 50 cast features 24 returning players, including Survivor legends Cirie Fields, Benjamin “Coach” Wade, Ozzy Lusth, and Colby Donaldson (all castaways with at least three past appearances), and three Survivor winners, Dee Valladares (Season 45 Sole Survivor), Kyle Fraser (Season 48 Sole Survivor), and Savannah Louie (Season 49 Sole Survivor). Survivor 50 marks the first time the show has featured returning players since 2020’s Season 40 (aka Survivor: Winners at War).
